title: Lydia Jersey Shift Dress | Washed Black

desc:

title: Safe Skirt - Trippy Flowers - Space (Women)
desc:
Safe Skirt is a shorter version of the Cosmic Skirt, with a wrap-around waistline and two Japanese snap buttons on the waist for closure. Proudly made locally in Belgium. 
Trippy Flowers is a bold, in-house designed print that brings playful energy and colour to this standout fabric. As the highlight fabric of the collection, it captures the joyful spirit of Howlin' like no other. Printed on lightweight cotton, it features our custom "crunchy" wash — giving the fabric a distinct texture and a lived-in feel straight off the rack. The vibrant floral motif is a true Howlin' original, full of character and charm.
Each garment is produced in small batches with close attention to detail in our Howlin' atelier.
Model is 173 cm and wears size S.

title: TINO DOUBLE PLEATED WIDE EASY PANT - DUNE LINEN TWILL
desc:
Our widest leg trouser with zero taper, we're excited to reintroduce the Tino in 100% linen twill.  After feedback that last fall's iteration ran narrow through the top block, we eased the measurements and added elastic in the back of the waistband for a truer-to-size, more comfortable fit.
The Tino fits easy through the top block with deep double reverse pleats and a full cut leg all the way to the hem.  It features 1/4 top pockets, two besom back pockets and a zip fly.
Proudly made in India.
This garment runs true to size.  We recommend taking your usual alpha size or sizing down for a slimmer fit.
